<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈192.103 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass using only C, H, and O atoms is C₈H₁₆O₅ (calculated neutral mass 192.0998 Da, [M+H]⁺ 193.1071 Da), within experimental error and consistent with the observed isotopic pattern. Therefore the molecular formula is C8H16O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H16O5</final_answer>
